purpose: Owner-requested promoter research backlog. Independent of venue preferences and discovery adapter readiness; adding here does not activate any source.
editorialRule: Promoter candidates can cover multiple venues. Verify original bill, year, local start/doors, age and actual venue for each event. Do not attribute every bill to a promoter-associated venue. Do not bypass platform access controls or invent a promoter feed.
